recognize_zh: 同一種淋巴球聚集在這張免疫染色幾乎全為陰性，只有極少數零星棕色陽性細胞；抗體未標示，依標題推測是 B 細胞標記（如 CD20），代表 rituximab 後聚集內 B 細胞缺乏。
features: Interstitial lymphoid aggregate of small cells, appearing more hypercellular than surrounding marrow
Aggregate essentially negative for the stain
Only rare scattered positive cells within and around the aggregate
Surrounding hematopoietic marrow negative with hematoxylin counterstain
Fat spaces and trabecular edge at the periphery
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows an interstitial lymphoid aggregate that is essentially negative, with only rare scattered positive cells. The surrounding marrow is negative. The antibody is not labeled; if this is a B-cell marker such as CD20, the aggregate lacks B cells. Because rituximab may cause loss of CD20 expression by residual neoplastic B cells, a negative CD20 stain should be complemented by PAX5 or CD79a before concluding that the aggregate represents reactive T-cell hyperplasia.

ddx.dx: Residual CD20-negative B-cell lymphoma after rituximab
ddx.vs: Residual lymphoma loses CD20 but remains PAX5/CD79a/CD19-positive and light-chain restricted.
A CD20-negative aggregate composed of atypical T cells with aberrant antigen loss and TCR clonality would indicate T-cell lymphoma rather than reactive hyperplasia.
CD138/MUM1 or MPO/CD117 staining identifies non-lymphoid aggregates that would also be CD20-negative.
